response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph 2, cloud formation","severity":"major","source_quote":"“water condenses onto microscopic ‘seeds’”","suggested_fix":"Replace “maji huganda juu ya” with “maji huganda/kujikusanya kwa kuganda juu ya” only if describing freezing; for condensation, use “mvuke wa maji huganda na kuwa matone juu ya” or another clear rendering of water vapor condensing onto the seeds.","translation_quote":"“maji huganda juu ya ‘mbegu’ ndogo sana”"},{"location":"Paragraph 6, description of Mount Horeb’s height","severity":"major","source_quote":"“from twelve hundred to fifteen hundred feet in perpendicular height”","suggested_fix":"Correct the figures to “kutoka futi elfu moja na mia mbili hadi elfu moja na mia tano kwa wima.”","translation_quote":"“kutoka urefu wa futi mia moja na ishirini hadi mia moja na hamsini kwa wima”"},{"location":"Paragraph 9, sacrificing today’s sunshine","severity":"major","source_quote":"“God is willing that we should sacrifice the shimmering sunshine of today for the fullness of His presence tomorrow.”","suggested_fix":"Replace “tutekeleze jua linalong’aa la leo” with “tujinyime mwanga unaong’aa wa leo” or another natural rendering of sacrificing/giving up today’s sunshine.","translation_quote":"“Mungu yuko tayari tutekeleze jua linalong’aa la leo kwa ajili ya utimilifu wa uwepo wake kesho.”"}],"findings_complete":true,"passed":false,"score":89}
